name: hup
description: hup — the built-in "You should know" heads-ups, piped to Claude. Each heads-up the side agent raises reaches the main agent mid-turn, behind its next tool result, as a fallible note to check before acting on it; Claude looks up the explainer with a tool and tells you about the heads-up: it may leave out only a slip of its own it has simply fixed, or a passing mishap, never one about your work or choices, a choice of its own that changes what you get, or a decision that is yours, now or later. By default the heads-up then leaves your screen, so it never counts as ignored. Function hooks only: one lookup tool, no command hooks, no MCP server, no settings patching.

push.title: Which heads-ups to send to Claude
push.description: all (default): every heads-up goes to Claude. heads-up: only "Heads up" lines (about the work); "You should know" ones stay on screen and in the lookup tool. none: never send; the lookup tool only.

swallow.title: Hide heads-ups once Claude has them
swallow.description: On (default): a heads-up sent to Claude leaves your screen once Claude's next request carries it, so it never counts as ignored, and Claude tells you about it: it may leave out only a slip of its own it has simply fixed, or a passing mishap, never one about your work or choices, a choice of its own that changes what you get, or a decision that is yours, now or later. Off: it stays on screen as well.
